rows.title: The Exchange has sought clarification from Jain Irrigation Systems Ltd on October 08, 2026, with reference to Movement in Volume. The reply is awaited.
Spurt in Volume
rows.summary: Significant increase in volume has been observed in Jain Irrigation Systems Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. Jain Irrigation Systems Limited has submitted their response.
